session_note: New Jersey's 221st Legislature (2024-2025 session) adjourned sine die in mid-January 2026 (final flurry of floor action 2026-01-12, new 222nd Legislature seated 2026-01-13); NJ does not carry bills across a Legislature boundary with the same number, so any 2024-2025 bill not enacted before that changeover is dead and would need reintroduction as a new bill in 2026-2027 to advance. The 222nd Legislature (2026-2027 session) began 2026-01-13 and runs as a single continuous biennium into January 2028, so a 2026-2027 bill sitting in committee as of 2026-07-31 is simply pending, not dead or 'carried_over' in the cross-Legislature sense; true carried_over status would only apply if checking status deep into 2027 for a bill still alive from 2026.
